title: Musicians in Netto's family
summary: Netto says only his cousin's son Rene Netto played music; his father did not.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Were anybody in your family musicals, anybody? Besides you?
No, there's Rene Netto. His dad was a cousin of mine. That's the only one that I know. You've probably heard of Rene. Yeah. Well, Rene's daddy is a cousin of mine, but I never see Rene.
And the father didn't play anything? My father, no.
He knew how to play race horses. Yeah. You know how to shoot dice.
